notes: Intelligent mode: an AUTO charge stops once the outage schedule says the battery will reach the grid; the late-grid buffer is a setting (default 15 min)
DTEK outage schedule and night plan in Telegram: charge goal, latest generator start, quiet-hours outlook
Quiet hours: emergency charge to 35% with no second start near their end; new /quiet and /skipnight commands
Charge current follows the source (20 A generator, 40 A grid) and is retried until the inverter confirms it
Fuel pump pressed once per generator run; grid-sensor glitches under generator load are vetoed by the meter
CI host tests build on Linux again (no firmware change)
